sources.title: Chha Mana Atha Guntha: chapter1 Ramachandra Mangaraj
sources.note: Chapter 1, opening passage introducing Ramachandra Mangaraj and the narrator’s explanations for food disappearing on fasting nights. The selected Odia passage was inspected in a community transcription; it was not collated against a printed facsimile. The interpretation that follows is a reading of this passage, not a claim about a historical person.

sources.title: Pratibha Ray · Jajnaseni
sources.note: The author-hosted English excerpt of Jajnaseni, opening Himalayan-journey passage: Draupadi reflects on attachment and describes falling while her husbands continue. The page does not identify the translator; no translator credit is inferred. This is a selected excerpt, not a review of the complete novel.
